subject: POC hands-on session — pre-read, routing checklist & calendar alignment

Subject: Re: POC planning — our team's availability

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the outline you shared in the demo. We chatted internally — our product and infra teams want a hands-on session where we can run a couple of routing scenarios and a short load test on synthetic traffic.

Couple of constraints:
- We need the session to start no earlier than 10:00 PT on any day (our compliance folks are tied up before that).
- Priya and I can commit to 90 minutes. If you need longer, we should split into two blocks.
- We have two prompts (billing reconciliation and patient summary generation) we'd like to walk through for prompt review.

Can you propose 2 possible windows next week? Also please send any pre-reads and a routing checklist so our infra leads can preconfigure a lightweight sandbox.

Thanks,
Jonas

--
Jonas Reed
Director of Product, Beacon Health
jonas.reed@beaconhealth.com

Cheers,
Rishi

Date: 2027-04-12T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC planning — sandbox checklist review

Quick review of the checklist (routing checklist v1):
- Network: need IP allowlist from Beacon for the lightweight sandbox. Jonas — can you share the CIDR or host list?
- Keys: we'll provide ephemeral API key scoped to sandbox; recommend 2 keys (one for routing/ingest, one for load generator).
- Load test: recommend 100 concurrent connections with 1k token bursts for 10 minutes to validate autoscaling path — that will be enough to surface any throttling.
- KV cache: we'll enable prefix caching for prompt templates used in the billing flow.

Marissa/Laura — I can stand up the sandbox 24 hours ahead if Jonas can provide the allowlist and confirm the two prompt payloads.

Dev
